problem:
The matrix $C$ and the vector $b$ are given below.
Determine if $b\in \text{Col}(C).$ 
In the affirmative case, find the value of ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}\cdot {x}_{3}$, where ${x}_{1},{x}_{2}$ and ${x}_{3}$ are real numbers such that $b={x}_{1}{c}_{1}+{x}_{2}{c}_{2}+{x}_{3}{c}_{3},$ and ${c}_{1}$, ${c}_{2}$, and ${c}_{3}$ are the respective columns of $C.$

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 3 \\ 0 & 2 & -1 \\ -1 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ -12 \\ -6\end{aligned}]
$$

activity_context.topic_title: The Column Space of a Matrix

feedback.problem:
The matrix $M$ and the vector $b$ are given below.
Determine if $b\in \text{Col}(M).$ 
In the affirmative case, find the value of ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}\cdot {x}_{3}\cdot {x}_{4}$, where ${x}_{1}$, ${x}_{2}$, ${x}_{3}$, and ${x}_{4}$ are real numbers such that $b={x}_{1}{m}_{1}+{x}_{2}{m}_{2}+{x}_{3}{m}_{3}+{x}_{4}{m}_{4},$ and ${m}_{1}$, ${m}_{2}$, ${m}_{3}$, and ${m}_{4}$ are respective columns of $M.$

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -2 & 4 \\ 1 & 2 & 0 & -1 \\ -3 & -3 & 6 & -12\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
In order to determine whether $b$ lies in $\text{Col}(M),$ we need to check if the equation $Mx=b$ is consistent. So, let's find the row echelon form of the augmented matrix $[M\,|\,b]$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[M\,|\,b] & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -2 & 4 & -3 \\ 1 & 2 & 0 & -1 & 1 \\ -3 & -3 & 6 & -12 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{2}+3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -2 & 4 & -3 \\ 1 & 2 & 0 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & -8\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we have the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}-2{x}_{3}+4{x}_{4}=-3 \\ {x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}-{x}_{4}=1 \\ 0=8.\end{aligned}
$$

From the third equation, we get a false statement $0=8.$ Therefore, the system is inconsistent, and we conclude that $b\notin \text{Col}(M).$
